title: Missing work
summary: The current source editor is useful but not complete. Priority work is to replace the package-local publication fallback with oorexx_atomic_file, repair the tiny CLI argument parser so quoted/multi-word search expressions survive process argv handling, add references/impact and guarded patch/proposed-change operations, bind the ooRexx CLI UI directly to SourceDocument/completion objects, and add a provider adapter for reading materialised projections from Semantic Source Store without granting the editor semantic mutation authority.
tasks: Atomic File backed publication with expected-generation and backup policy evidence.
Argv-correct CLI parsing for multi-word literals and regexes.
References, callers/callees and impact navigation over language scanners.
Guarded ProposedChange/patch object with base identity/hash precondition.
Direct ooRexx CLI UI binding to SourceDocument and SourceCompletionProvider.
Read/materialise adapter boundary for Development Desk / Semantic Source Store.
Integrate Source Editor capability into the native NewShell worker/client/runtime surface rather than maintaining a side CLI only.
